model.covariance: one complete 4x4 covariance; hands and Re/Im are not independent votes

ranking.primary: minimum joint GLS chi_square with 2 df
ranking.normalized_weights: normalize the three relative likelihoods over the frozen model set
ranking.phase_residual: wrapped observed ratio phase minus exact target phase; descriptive only

reflection_null: score only the true reflected pair null supplied by the engine; same-parent plus/minus conjugacy is not a null
